mapper.select: select inbound_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_detail_id, order_no, item_type, item_id, product_id, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, receipt_batch_id, receipt_batch_detail_id, quality_inspection_id, quantity, inspected_quantity, accepted_quantity, rejected_quantity, concession_quantity, qc_result, qc_user, qc_time, qc_remark, create_by, create_time, remark from inv_inbound_record where purchase_order_id = #{orderId}

select inbound_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_detail_id, order_no, item_type, item_id, product_id, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, receipt_batch_id, receipt_batch_detail_id, quality_inspection_id, quantity, inspected_quantity, accepted_quantity, rejected_quantity, concession_quantity, qc_result, qc_user, qc_time, qc_remark, create_by, create_time, remark from inv_inbound_record where purchase_order_id = #{orderId} and (qc_result is null or qc_result = 'pending')

select inbound_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_detail_id, order_no, item_type, item_id, product_id, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, receipt_batch_id, receipt_batch_detail_id, quality_inspection_id, quantity, inspected_quantity, accepted_quantity, rejected_quantity, concession_quantity, qc_result, qc_user, qc_time, qc_remark, create_by, create_time, remark from inv_inbound_record where receipt_batch_detail_id = #{batchDetailId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into inv_inbound_record ( purchase_order_id, purchase_detail_id, order_no, item_type, item_id, product_id, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, receipt_batch_id, receipt_batch_detail_id, quality_inspection_id, quantity, inspected_quantity, accepted_quantity, rejected_quantity, concession_quantity, qc_result, qc_user, qc_time, qc_remark, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{purchaseOrderId}, #{purchaseDetailId}, #{orderNo}, coalesce(#{itemType}, 'product'), coalesce(#{itemId}, #{productId}), #{productId}, #{shopDeptId}, #{warehouseId}, #{receiptBatchId}, #{receiptBatchDetailId}, #{qualityInspectionId}, #{quantity}, #{inspectedQuantity}, #{acceptedQuantity}, #{rejectedQuantity}, #{concessionQuantity}, #{qcResult}, #{qcUser}, #{qcTime}, #{qcRemark}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: delete from inv_inbound_record where purchase_order_id = #{orderId} and qc_result = 'rejected' and receipt_batch_id is null
